title: JFG-Studio galaxies/<name>.json: a planet map of the pack's own, which the player switches to with L / R

name.description: the name shown at the top of the map

home.description: the planet the cursor starts on when the player switches to this galaxy (one of its planets). The galaxy appears on L / R once any of its planets is open: from the start (unlock "start"), or once entered through a portal (unlock {"entered": itself})
